description: Empty-input behavior is checked; this is not a measured count of real sensor outages.
An event with no matching scheduled discharge is handled as a manual-inspection case; no field error count is inferred.
Unavailable schedule evidence is represented as unavailable rather than a positive match; no count is measured.
Missing or conflicting flow does not establish upstream support; no field error count is inferred.
Multiple candidates remain independently ranked; this test is not a measured attribution error count.
The ranking reason can state that timing does not establish supported transport; the report does not aggregate these cases.
Missing operation evidence is unavailable and limits ranking priority; no field error count is measured.
The optional genuine citizen-science input is absent; the synthetic raw scenario file is not treated as genuine evidence.
The optional satellite/environmental input is absent; no observation report is generated.
